reason: We need time tracking per client, and this doesn't do it, so I'd still be paying for a separate tracker on top. And per-seat pricing means my two on-and-off freelancers cost me money every month, which is exactly what I left behind with flat pricing.
objection: No per-client time tracking, and paying $15 a head for freelancers who only drop in some weeks.
would_change_my_mind: Built-in time tracking per client plus a flat price where occasional freelancers and clients get in free.
